test_article: one complete v105 lower hardpoint module per side, including v99 6.4 mm sockets and v103 fork tails; material/process must match intended production article

fixture.load_pin: 6.0 mm smooth steel proof pin for module test; actual carbon tube qualified separately
fixture.load_measurement: calibrated >=2 kN load cell or equivalent traceable force measurement
fixture.displacement_measurement: dial indicator or digital indicator at socket center, resolution <=0.01 mm

sequence: inspect and measure bore diameter/ovalization baseline at two orthogonal directions
apply proof load 1.50x design for 10 s
unload, inspect, remeasure bore and permanent set
repeat a 0.50x design stiffness check and compare with pre-proof stiffness
2.0x case is destructive/sensitivity qualification only, not required on every production article
safety: use rigid shielding and stand clear of line-of-fire at >=0.9 kN load
do not use a human-held luggage scale as the reaction structure
compression tests require a short guided proof pin to avoid rod buckling
stop immediately on cracking, progressive displacement, fixture slip or load-cell instability
